title: "Running script" concept doesn't check if [[ScriptOrModule]] is null
body:
The current definition for `running script` is: > The running script is the [script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-script) in the [[HostDefined]] field in the ScriptOrModule component of the [running JavaScript execution context](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#running-execution-context). https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#running-script However, `[[ScriptOrModule]]` can be null, for example, in event handler attributes: ```html
``` For reference, [[ScriptOrModule]] is set to null for event handler attributes here: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#getting-the-current-value-of-the-event-handler > 3. If eventHandler's [value](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#event-handler-value) is an [internal raw uncompiled handler](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#internal-raw-uncompiled-handler), then: > ... > 11. Set function.[[ScriptOrModule]] to null. In the above example, the event handler will end up calling `HostPromiseRejectionTracker(promise, operation)` with a null `[[ScriptOrModule]]`, which assumes `running script` is non-null: > 1. Let script be the [running script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#running-script). > 2. If script is a [classic script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#classic-script) and script's [muted errors](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#muted-errors) is true, terminate these steps. > 3. Let settings object be script's [settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#settings-object). https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#the-hostpromiserejectiontracker-implementation This also happens with built-in function objects, which perform their operation in an execution context with the `[[ScriptOrModule]]` set to null: https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-built-in-function-objects-call-thisargument-argumentslist > 7. Set the ScriptOrModule of calleeContext to null. In our engine, we currently bail if the running script is null, because it will crash with a nullptr deference otherwise: https://github.com/SerenityOS/serenity/blob/e85b3fc750414045d47fa3dfa99075b535b9b8af/Userland/Libraries/LibWeb/Bindings/MainThreadVM.cpp#L56-L75 We currently run into this issue a lot on sites that use promises as our engine is missing a lot of features, causing promises to unexpectedly fail and thus making this issue prominent.
